public.summary: On 31 August 2023 in meeting S/PV.9409, the Council adopted resolution 2695 (2023) by 13 votes in favour, none against, with China and the Russian Federation abstaining. Brazil voted in favour. The mandate expires 31 August 2024; UNIFIL acts without prior permission within its mandate and continues coordination with Lebanon's Government under the status-of-forces agreement.

Russia.summary: Russia position: “Russia attributed its abstention to contentious late drafting changes” “It continued to support the mission's activities”
